events.speaker: CONSTANCE
events.text: Your books don't balance. I'd have said nothing if it were a shilling. It isn't a shilling.

events.speaker: CONSTANCE
events.text: There. Third column, second week. Someone either can't add or didn't want you to notice. I'd bet on the second.

events.speaker: CONSTANCE
events.text: Standing work, not a favor paid once. I'll keep your numbers honest whether you ask or not.

events.speaker: CONSTANCE
events.text: I take my spectacles off to make a point. I've been taking them off around you rather a lot lately.
